description: Chart notes on a rank tracker's own timeline — 'deployed new title tags', 'algorithm update' — oldest first. FREE: database only, no SEO data provider is called and no credits are spent. Config-level, not per-keyword or per-device: a deploy or algorithm change is a fact about the date, not about any one reading.

configId.description: Rank tracker config ID. Call get_rank_tracker without a trackerId to list the project's trackers and their IDs.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.
